parameters.query: WITH last_week AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days' AS wk_start, date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) AS wk_end) SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.bedrijfsnaam, c.owner_voornaam, c.owner_email, c.slug, c.founder_voornaam, c.founder_whatsapp, EXTRACT(week FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days')::int AS weeknr, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id) FILTER (WHERE ca.started_at >= (SELECT wk_start FROM last_week) AND ca.started_at < (SELECT wk_end FROM last_week)), 0) AS calls_taken, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ev.id) FILTER (WHERE ev.event_type = 'call.missed' AND ev.occurred_at >= (SELECT wk_start FROM last_week) AND ev.occurred_at < (SELECT wk_end FROM last_week)), 0) AS missed_recovered, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.created_at >= (SELECT wk_start FROM last_week) AND b.created_at < (SELECT wk_end FROM last_week)), 0) AS bookings, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.received_at >= (SELECT wk_start FROM last_week) AND r.received_at < (SELECT wk_end FROM last_week)), 0) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(r.rating) FILTER (WHERE r.received_at >= (SELECT wk_start FROM last_week) AND r.received_at < (SELECT wk_end FROM last_week))::numeric, 1) AS avg_rating FROM clients c LEFT JOIN calls ca ON ca.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN events ev ON ev.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.client_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.onboarding_completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id;

SELECT summary FROM calls WHERE client_id = $1::uuid AND started_at >= date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days' AND started_at < date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list WHERE email_hash = encode(digest(lower($1), 'sha256'), 'hex')) AS email_suppressed;
